name: Home Assistant
description: Lights, switches and scenes from your Home Assistant, as tap-to-toggle tiles on the phone.
author: PhoneDesk

settings.label: Home Assistant address
settings.hint: On your home network. Addresses like 192.168.x.x or .local names only.

settings.label: Long-lived access token
settings.hint: In Home Assistant: your profile, Security, Long-lived access tokens. The token stays on this PC; the phone never sees it.

settings.label: What to show
settings.hint: Entity ids separated by commas: lights, switches, fans, input booleans and scenes.

widgets.title: Home switches
widgets.description: Your Home Assistant lights, switches and scenes as tap-to-toggle tiles.
